paper.title_en: A No-Go Theorem for Type-3 New General Relativity on $Λ$CDM Background
paper.abstract_en: We investigate whether Type-3 New General Relativity can alleviate the cosmic growth tension. On a $Λ$CDM background, we derive the scalar perturbation equations and find the effective gravitational coupling to exceed Newton's constant throughout the parameter range compatible with ghost-free and background-hierarchy conditions. By confronting the theoretical model with growth-rate measurements from major galaxy redshift surveys, including WiggleZ, SDSS-IV eBOSS, BOSS, and VIPERS, we obtain constraints on the effective coupling that are consistent with the $Λ$CDM value. Consequently, the conditions for stability and tension reduction are mutually exclusive.
